items.title: End of tenancy (landlord's ordinary termination)
items.quote: hiermit kündige ich das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Ruhrallee 77, 2. Obergeschoss rechts, ordentlich zum 28.02.2027.
items.computation: The letter was hand-delivered (per Boten) into the tenant's mailbox on Thursday, 19.11.2026 around 10:00, and the landlord gives an explicit, fixed termination date of 28.02.2027 for the ordinary (Eigenbedarf) termination of the lease. No period calculation is needed since the calendar date is stated directly.

items.title: Deadline for tenant to object to termination (§§574–574b BGB)
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens am 31.12.2026 zugehen.
items.computation: The letter explicitly states the final date by which a written (Textform) objection (Widerspruch) under §§574–574b BGB against the termination must reach (zugehen) the landlord, i.e. 31.12.2026. 31.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW (Silvester is not a statutory holiday), so no §193 BGB extension applies; the stated date stands.

warnings: This is a landlord's own notice of termination of the tenancy, not an authority decision; the tenant should check whether the stated 'Eigenbedarf' (need for the daughter) justification is accurate and, if they wish to object or contest the move-out, respond in writing well before 31.12.2026.

No specific move-out/handover date is fixed yet ('werde ich mich rechtzeitig mit Ihnen abstimmen'), so the person should expect a follow-up letter or contact to arrange the actual handover around 28.02.2027.
